latest.notes: Elements now always hand over at the segue cue. A song whose intro was under a second used to hold the element before it all the way to its end, so reordering the log could cost the song that was playing its segue and crossfade. Cue points are now always respected. Note that categories set to not fade at the segue (imaging, sweepers, jingles, legal IDs and promos by default) hold full volume through their tail — change that per category in Settings, Audio.
